sourceIssues: Several slide notes contain answer letters inconsistent with the visible questions and neighboring notes. These letters were not used as answer keys.

Course slides include broad or simplified clinical statements. Questions omit non-rebreather CO2 rebreathing, automatic intubation by a CO2 cutoff alone, a universal peripheral potassium rate, blanket renal protein limits, and unqualified hypoxic-drive explanations.
Concept Mastery scope is now supplied by a term performance report. It has no original question text; new items are authored against its competencies and clinically supported by named course lessons.
deduplication: Exact normalized stems and within-item choices checked automatically; repeated concepts are intentionally tested through multiple approaches. No claim of exhaustive semantic uniqueness.
